result.summary: Several visual and content bugs: a raw localization key is shown as a section title, restaurant cards and category chips are clipped, and the last featured card is cut off by the tab bar.

issues.description: The section heading displays the untranslated key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a human-readable title.
issues.suggestion: Replace the i18n key with the localized string (e.g. 'Popular near you') and add a fallback so missing translations never render the key.

issues.description: The third 'Fastest near you' card (Trattoria Piccol…) is clipped on the right, cutting off the restaurant name and part of the image.
issues.suggestion: Give the horizontal list enough padding/peek, or allow cards to wrap/scroll fully so names and images are not truncated.

issues.description: The last featured restaurant card is cut off at the bottom by the tab bar, hiding most of the pizza image and any details below it.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding equal to the tab bar height (plus safe area) so the last card can scroll fully into view.

issues.description: The category chip row is clipped on the right (partial 'Healthy' chip and a cut-off next chip).
issues.suggestion: Allow the chip row to scroll horizontally with visible overflow or add end padding so the last chips aren’t cropped.

issues.description: Restaurant names in the fastest-near-you row wrap or truncate unevenly (e.g. 'Trattoria Piccol').
issues.suggestion: Use consistent two-line ellipsis or a slightly smaller type size so names remain readable without being cut mid-word.
